        const siteDevices = devices.filter((device) => snapshot ? Boolean(device.sourceDeviceId && snapshotIds.has(device.sourceDeviceId)) : device.location.trim() === label);
        const priorities = siteDevices.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "overdue" || device.lifecycleStatus === "due-soon");
        const storageDevices = siteDevices.filter((device) => { const value = storageStatus(device); return value === "critical" || value === "watch"; });
        const virtualDevices = siteDevices.filter((device) => device.type === "vm");
        const osDevices = siteDevices.filter((device) => { const value = osSupportStatus(device); return value === "unsupported" || value === "ending-soon"; });
        return {
          label,
          devices: siteDevices,
          priorities,
          storageDevices,
          virtualDevices,
          osDevices,
          current: siteDevices.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "current").length,
          dueSoon: siteDevices.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "due-soon").length,
          overdue: siteDevices.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "overdue").length,
          projects: projectPackages.filter((item) => snapshot ? item.locationIds.includes(snapshot.id) : false),
        };
      });
      const locationPackets = locationGroups.map((group) => {
        const byDevice = new Map<string, { device: (typeof devices)[number]; concerns: Array<{ tone: string; icon: ReportIconName; label: string; detail: string }> }>();
        const addConcern = (device: (typeof devices)[number], concern: { tone: string; icon: ReportIconName; label: string; detail: string }) => {
          const key = device.sourceDeviceId || `${device.location}|${clientDeviceDisplayName(device)}`;
          const current = byDevice.get(key) || { device, concerns: [] };
          if (!current.concerns.some((item) => item.label === concern.label && item.detail === concern.detail)) current.concerns.push(concern);
          byDevice.set(key, current);
        };
        group.priorities.forEach((device) => {
          const warrantyValue = warrantyStatus(device, warrantyReference);
          addConcern(device, {
            tone: device.lifecycleStatus === "overdue" ? "priority" : "attention",
            icon: "computer",
            label: device.lifecycleStatus === "overdue" ? "Age and warranty" : "Planning window",
            detail: `${formatReportAge(device.age)} · ${warrantyStatusLabel(warrantyValue)}${device.warrantyExpires ? ` through ${device.warrantyExpires}` : ""}. ${device.lifecycleStatus === "overdue" ? "This system should stay on the near-term roadmap." : "This system is approaching its normal planning window."}`,
          });
        });
        group.storageDevices.forEach((device) => addConcern(device, {
          tone: storageStatus(device) === "critical" ? "priority" : "attention",
          icon: "storage",
          label: "Storage capacity",
          detail: `Disk volume usage: ${storageUsageSummary(device) || "usage needs review"}. Review cleanup, archiving, or expansion.`,
        }));
        group.osDevices.forEach((device) => {
          const value = osSupportStatus(device);
          const recommendation = value === "unsupported"
            ? device.type === "server" || device.type === "vm"
              ? "Review the best upgrade, migration, or retirement path."
              : "Review whether it should be upgraded to a supported version or replaced."
            : /Windows\s*11/i.test(device.os) && /\bHome\b/i.test(device.os)
              ? "Review whether Windows 11 Pro is the right fit for the business environment."
              : "Review the timing for a supported operating-system update.";
          addConcern(device, { tone: value === "unsupported" ? "priority" : "attention", icon: "windows", label: "Operating system", detail: `${device.os || "Operating system not reported"}. ${recommendation}` });
        });
        const deviceCards = [...byDevice.values()].map(({ device, concerns }) => {
          const model = `${device.make} ${device.model}`.trim() || deviceTypeLabelForDevice(device);
          const highestTone = concerns.some((item) => item.tone === "priority") ? "priority" : "attention";
          return `<article class="pdf-device-focus-card ${highestTone}"><div class="pdf-device-focus-head">${reportIconHtml("computer")}<div><span>${escapeHtml(deviceTypeLabelForDevice(device))}</span><h3>${escapeHtml(clientDeviceDisplayName(device))}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(model)}</p></div></div><div class="pdf-device-concerns">${concerns.map((concern) => `<div class="${concern.tone}">${reportIconHtml(concern.icon)}<span><strong>${escapeHtml(concern.label)}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(concern.detail)}</small></span></div>`).join("")}</div></article>`;
        });
        const agreedSiteProjects = group.projects.filter((item) => item.source === "review-outcome").map((item, index) => `<article class="pdf-agreed-site-card"><b>${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</b><div><span>Agreed plan</span><h3>${escapeHtml(item.title)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(item.technicalDrivers.join(" · ") || item.advantageResponsibility)}</p></div></article>`);
        const cards = [...agreedSiteProjects, ...deviceCards];
        if (!cards.length) return "";
        const summaryCards = [
          `<article class="healthy">${reportIconHtml("check")}<span><strong>${group.current}</strong><small>Systems in good shape</small></span></article>`,
          group.priorities.length ? `<article class="attention">${reportIconHtml("computer")}<span><strong>${group.priorities.length}</strong><small>Aging system${group.priorities.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</small></span></article>` : "",
          group.storageDevices.length ? `<article class="storage">${reportIconHtml("storage")}<span><strong>${group.storageDevices.length}</strong><small>Storage item${group.storageDevices.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} to review</small></span></article>` : "",
          group.osDevices.length ? `<article class="os">${reportIconHtml("windows")}<span><strong>${group.osDevices.length}</strong><small>Operating-system item${group.osDevices.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} to review</small></span></article>` : "",
        ].filter(Boolean).join("");
        const pages: string[] = [];
        for (let index = 0; index < cards.length; index += 6) {
          const chunk = cards.slice(index, index + 6);
          const pageNumber = Math.floor(index / 6) + 1;
          const pageTotal = Math.ceil(cards.length / 6);
          const footerLabel = locationGroups.length > 1 ? `${group.label} · Radar Items` : "Items to Keep on Your Radar";
          pages.push(`<section class="pdf-page pdf-focus-page" data-pdf-page="true"><header class="pdf-section-header"><span class="kicker">${locationGroups.length > 1 ? `${escapeHtml(group.label)} · ` : ""}Technology recap${pageTotal > 1 ? ` · ${pageNumber} of ${pageTotal}` : ""}</span><h2>${locationGroups.length > 1 ? `${escapeHtml(group.label)}: what to keep on your radar` : "What to keep on your radar"}</h2><p>Most of the environment is in good shape. The items below deserve attention over time so they can be addressed thoughtfully and before they create unnecessary disruption.</p></header>${pageNumber === 1 ? `<div class="pdf-focus-summary">${summaryCards}</div>` : ""}<div class="pdf-device-focus-grid">${chunk.join("")}</div>${pdfFooter(footerLabel)}</section>`);
        }
        return pages.join("");
      }).join("");
      const siteOverview = locationGroups.length > 1 ? `<div class="pdf-site-overview-grid">${locationGroups.map((group) => `<article><strong>${escapeHtml(group.label)}</strong><span>${group.overdue} priority · ${group.dueSoon} approaching lifecycle · ${group.storageDevices.length} storage · ${group.osDevices.length} OS · ${group.virtualDevices.length} virtual · ${group.projects.length} projects</span></article>`).join("")}</div>` : "";
      const hipaaResponseLabel = (response: "yes" | "partially" | "no" | "not-applicable" | "not-yet-assessed", deferred = false) => deferred || response === "not-yet-assessed" ? "Not sure" : response === "partially" ? "Somewhat" : response === "not-applicable" ? "Does not apply" : response === "yes" ? "Yes" : "No";
      const hipaaReportItems = project.hipaa.enabled ? HIPAA_QUESTIONS.flatMap((question) => {
        const answer = project.hipaa.answers.find((item) => item.questionId === question.id);
        const response = answer?.response ?? "not-yet-assessed";
        if (response !== "partially" && response !== "no" && response !== "not-yet-assessed" && !answer?.deferred) return [];
        if (answer && !answer.includeInReport) return [];
        return [{ question, answer, response }];
      }).sort((left, right) => {
        const order = { no: 0, "not-yet-assessed": 1, partially: 2, "not-applicable": 3, yes: 4 } as const;
        return order[left.response] - order[right.response];
      }) : [];
      const renderHipaaReportItem = ({ question, answer, response }: (typeof hipaaReportItems)[number]) => {
        const observation = answer?.clientVisibleObservation.trim() ?? "";
        const action = answer?.recommendedAction.trim() ?? "";
        const detail = hipaaClientFacingFollowUp(question, answer);
        return `<article class="pdf-hipaa-review-finding ${response}"><div class="pdf-hipaa-review-finding-head"><strong>${escapeHtml(question.title)}</strong><span>${escapeHtml(hipaaResponseLabel(response, answer?.deferred))}</span></div><small>${escapeHtml(adaptOrganizationLanguage(detail, project))}</small>${action && action !== observation && action !== detail ? `<small><b>Next action:</b> ${escapeHtml(adaptOrganizationLanguage(action, project))}</small>` : ""}</article>`;
      };
      const hipaaDistribution = project.hipaa.enabled ? [
        ["yes", "Yes", hipaa.counts.yes],
        ["partially", "Somewhat", hipaa.counts.partially],
        ["no", "No", hipaa.counts.no],
        ["na", "Does not apply", hipaa.counts["not-applicable"]],
        ["skipped", "Not sure", hipaa.counts["not-yet-assessed"]],
      ] as const : [];
      const hipaaDistributionTotal = Math.max(1, hipaaDistribution.reduce((sum, [, , count]) => sum + count, 0));
      const hipaaDistributionBar = hipaaDistribution.map(([key, , count]) => `<i class="${key}" style="width:${(count / hipaaDistributionTotal) * 100}%"></i>`).join("");
      const hipaaDistributionLegend = hipaaDistribution.filter(([, , count]) => count > 0).map(([key, label, count]) => `<span class="${key}"><i></i><b>${count}</b>${escapeHtml(label)}</span>`).join("");
      const hipaaFollowUpCount = project.hipaa.enabled ? hipaa.counts.no + hipaa.counts.partially + hipaa.counts["not-yet-assessed"] : 0;
      const consultantGuidance = project.hipaa.enabled ? hipaaConsultantGuidance(project) : null;
      const hipaaConfirmationDate = (() => {
        const source = project.hipaa.clientConfirmation.confirmedAt;
        if (!source) return "";
        const date = new Date(source);
        return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? source : new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { month: "long", day: "numeric", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(date);
      })();
      const hipaaConfirmation = project.hipaa.clientConfirmation.status === "confirmed"
        ? `<div class="pdf-hipaa-confirmation"><div><strong>Client review confirmed</strong><span>${escapeHtml(project.hipaa.clientConfirmation.confirmer || "Client representative")}${hipaaConfirmationDate ? ` · ${escapeHtml(hipaaConfirmationDate)}` : ""}</span></div><div><strong>Information responsibility acknowledged</strong><span>Client-provided information remains the client&#39;s responsibility.</span></div></div>`
        : `<div class="pdf-hipaa-confirmation pending"><div><strong>Client confirmation pending</strong><span>The readiness snapshot has not yet been confirmed by a client representative.</span></div></div>`;
      const summaryHipaaItems = hipaaReportItems.slice(0, 3);
      const printHipaaReview = project.hipaa.enabled ? `<section class="pdf-page pdf-hipaa-review" data-pdf-page="true">
          <header class="pdf-section-header"><span class="kicker">HIPAA readiness recap</span><h2>HIPAA readiness review</h2><p>A simple recap of the responses reviewed, the items that may need attention, and the next conversations to have. This readiness review does not determine HIPAA compliance.</p></header>
          <div class="pdf-hipaa-recap-hero"><article class="pdf-hipaa-primary-score">${scoreRingHtml(hipaa.overall, scoreTone(hipaa.overall))}<div><span>Overall readiness</span><strong>${escapeHtml(hipaa.label)}</strong><small>Based on the responses reviewed</small></div></article><div class="pdf-hipaa-review-metrics${hipaa.notYetAssessedCount > 0 ? "" : " without-not-sure"}"><article><strong>${hipaa.assessedQuestionCount}</strong><span>Questions answered</span><small>Of ${hipaa.applicableQuestionCount} applicable questions</small></article><article><strong>${hipaaFollowUpCount}</strong><span>Follow-up items</span><small>${hipaa.counts.no} No · ${hipaa.counts.partially} Somewhat</small></article>${hipaa.notYetAssessedCount > 0 ? `<article><strong>${hipaa.notYetAssessedCount}</strong><span>Not sure</span><small>Skipped or unanswered</small></article>` : ""}</div></div>
          <div class="pdf-hipaa-distribution"><div class="answer-bar">${hipaaDistributionBar}</div><div class="answer-legend">${hipaaDistributionLegend}</div></div>
          <div class="pdf-hipaa-meaning">${reportIconHtml("activity")}<span><strong>What this means</strong><small>This questionnaire highlights potential weaknesses based on the responses provided. It is not a formal audit, certification, or guarantee of HIPAA compliance.</small></span></div>
          ${consultantGuidance ? `<div class="pdf-hipaa-consultant-note ${consultantGuidance.tone}">${reportIconHtml("people")}<span><strong>${escapeHtml(consultantGuidance.title)}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(consultantGuidance.copy)}</small></span></div>` : ""}
          ${hipaaConfirmation}
          <div class="pdf-hipaa-followup-heading"><h3>Priority follow-up</h3><span>${hipaaReportItems.length > 3 ? `Showing the top 3 of ${hipaaReportItems.length} follow-up items` : hipaaReportItems.length ? `${hipaaReportItems.length} item${hipaaReportItems.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} to revisit` : "No open gaps identified"}</span></div>
          ${summaryHipaaItems.length ? `<div class="pdf-hipaa-review-findings">${summaryHipaaItems.map(renderHipaaReportItem).join("")}</div>` : `<div class="pdf-hipaa-no-followups">No No, Somewhat, or unanswered responses were identified in the completed assessment.</div>`}
          <div class="pdf-hipaa-disclaimer">${escapeHtml(HIPAA_DISCLAIMER)}</div>
          ${pdfFooter("HIPAA Readiness Recap")}
        </section>` : "";
      const printHipaaAnswers = project.hipaa.enabled ? `<section class="pdf-page pdf-hipaa-answers" data-pdf-page="true">
          <header class="pdf-section-header"><span class="kicker">HIPAA readiness · Answer record</span><h2>Reviewed answers</h2><p>The responses below are the current saved answers used to calculate the readiness score in this report.</p></header>
          <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px 10px;margin-top:10px">${HIPAA_QUESTIONS.map((question) => { const answer = project.hipaa.answers.find((item) => item.questionId === question.id); const response = answer?.response ?? "not-yet-assessed"; const label = hipaaResponseLabel(response, answer?.deferred); return `<article style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 11px;border:1px solid #d9e3ee;border-radius:10px;background:#f8fafc"><div style="min-width:0"><small style="display:block;color:#73839a;font-size:5.5pt;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800">${escapeHtml(question.id)} · ${escapeHtml(question.category.replace(" Safeguards", ""))}</small><strong style="display:block;margin-top:2px;color:#0b1830;font-size:7.2pt;line-height:1.2">${escapeHtml(question.title)}</strong></div><span style="flex:0 0 auto;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:#e8eef5;color:#445b76;font-size:6pt;font-weight:800">${escapeHtml(label)}</span></article>`; }).join("")}</div>
          <div class="pdf-hipaa-disclaimer">${escapeHtml(HIPAA_DISCLAIMER)}</div>
          ${pdfFooter("HIPAA Reviewed Answers")}
        </section>` : "";
      const printHipaaFollowUp = hipaaResponseAppendixHtml(project, "pdf-page", pdfFooter("HIPAA Follow-Up"));
      const actionContinuationPages = actionChunks.slice(1).map((items, pageIndex) => `<section class="pdf-page pdf-action-page pdf-action-continuation" data-pdf-page="true"><header class="pdf-section-header"><span class="kicker">${agreedPlan ? "Agreed plan" : "Recommended plan"} · Continued · ${pageIndex + 2} of ${actionChunks.length}</span><h2>${escapeHtml(planningTitle)}</h2><p>Additional packaged projects, responsibilities, and timing from the same technology roadmap.</p></header><div class="pdf-recommendation-list">${items.join("")}</div>${pdfFooter(agreedPlan ? "Agreed Roadmap" : approach.mode === "purchase-planning" ? "Recommended Next Step" : "Recommended Plan")}</section>`).join("");
      const printRecap = `<section class="pdf-page pdf-client-success-page" data-pdf-page="true">
          <header class="pdf-section-header"><span class="kicker">Next steps</span><h2>When you are ready, let&#39;s talk about what comes next.</h2><p>This report is meant to give you a clear picture of where things stand and what deserves attention. You do not need to address everything at once.</p></header>
          <aside class="pdf-focus-closing final"><strong>What this means for you</strong><p>We can review the priorities together, answer questions, and build a practical plan around timing, budget, software dependencies, and business impact.</p><p>If you are ready to talk about next steps, planning, or anything in this report, reach out to your Client Success Manager.</p></aside>
          <div class="pdf-csm-contact"><span class="kicker">Your Client Success Manager</span><h3>Patric Beckman</h3><p>Advantage Technologies</p><div><strong>877.723.8832 x511</strong><strong>patric.beckman@adv-tech.com</strong><strong>adv.tech</strong></div></div>
          ${pdfFooter("Next Steps")}
        </section>`;
    
      const printReport = `<div class="print-report">
        <section class="pdf-page pdf-cover" data-pdf-page="true">
          <header class="pdf-brandline"><span>${pdfBrandIdentityHtml()}</span><span>${escapeHtml(reviewLabel)}</span></header>
          <div class="pdf-cover-title"><span class="kicker">Prepared for ${escapeHtml(project.client.name)}</span><h1>${escapeHtml(reportTitle)}</h1><p>${escapeHtml(reportSummary)}</p><span class="prepared-pill">${escapeHtml(preparedDate(project))}</span></div>
          <div class="pdf-cover-score-row"><article class="pdf-overall-score">${scoreRingHtml(scores.overall, scoreTone(scores.overall))}<div class="pdf-overall-copy"><span>${scores.provisional ? "Provisional score" : "Overall technology health"}</span><b>${scoreLabel(scores.overall)}</b><small>${scores.provisional ? `The score will update after ${hipaa.notYetAssessedCount} unanswered HIPAA question${hipaa.notYetAssessedCount === 1 ? " is" : "s are"} completed and reviewed.` : "A combined view of protection, technology health, and readiness."}</small></div></article><article class="pdf-cover-status ${agingSystems.tone}">${reportIconHtml("computer")}<div><strong>${escapeHtml(agingSystemsLabel)}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(agingSystems.detail)}</small></div></article></div>
          <div class="pdf-score-grid"><article>${reportIconHtml("shield")}<div><strong class="status-word">${escapeHtml(scoreLabel(scores.security))}</strong><span>Security protection</span><small>Monitoring and response</small></div></article><article>${reportIconHtml("activity")}<div><strong class="status-word">${escapeHtml(scoreLabel(scores.network))}</strong><span>Technology health</span><small>${lifecycle.current} healthy · ${healthPriorities} aging systems</small></div></article>${project.hipaa.enabled ? `<article>${reportIconHtml("people")}<div><strong class="status-word">${escapeHtml(hipaa.label)}</strong><span>HIPAA readiness</span><small>${hipaa.assessedQuestionCount} questions answered</small></div></article>` : `<article>${reportIconHtml("computer")}<div><strong class="status-word">${lifecycle.current} of ${lifecycle.assessed}</strong><span>Equipment age health</span><small>assessed assets healthy</small></div></article>`}</div>
          <div class="pdf-evidence-grid"><article><strong>${lifecycle.inventoryTotal}</strong><span>Managed assets</span></article><article><strong>${lifecycle.current}</strong><span>Healthy assets</span></article><article><strong>${healthPriorities}</strong><span>Health priorities</span></article><article><strong>${incidents}</strong><span>Security incidents</span></article></div>
          ${pdfFooter("Technology Health Review")}
        </section>
    
        <section class="pdf-page pdf-overview-page" data-pdf-page="true">
          <header class="pdf-section-header"><span class="kicker">Current environment</span><h2>Security and technology health</h2><p>This section highlights the security activity, system health, and lifecycle items that are most important to review together.</p></header>
          <div class="pdf-overview-columns"><article class="pdf-overview-panel"><span>Security protection</span><h3>${escapeHtml(securityMessage.title)}</h3><div class="pdf-compact-metrics"><article><strong>${formatMetric(events)}</strong><span>Events analyzed</span><small>${entities} protected entities</small></article><article class="signal"><strong>${signals}</strong><span>Signals detected</span><small>${investigated} investigated</small></article><article class="incident${incidents ? " has-incident" : ""}"><strong>${incidents}</strong><span>Incidents</span><small>${incidents ? escapeHtml(incidentResponse.status) : "None reported"}</small></article></div>${incidentResponse.visible ? `<aside class="pdf-incident-response ${incidentResponse.actions.length ? "completed" : "reviewed"}"><div class="pdf-incident-copy"><span>Security team response</span><strong>${escapeHtml(incidentResponse.title)}</strong><p>${escapeHtml(incidentResponse.summary)}</p></div><div class="pdf-incident-details">${incidentResponse.device ? `<div><small>Affected computer</small><strong>${escapeHtml(incidentResponse.device)}</strong></div>` : ""}${incidentResponse.threat ? `<div><small>Threat identified</small><strong>${escapeHtml(incidentResponse.threat)}</strong></div>` : ""}<div class="outcome"><small>Outcome</small><strong>${escapeHtml(incidentResponse.status)}</strong></div></div>${incidentResponse.actions.length ? `<div class="pdf-incident-actions"><span>Actions taken</span><div>${incidentResponse.actions.map((action) => `<small><b>✓</b>${escapeHtml(action)}</small>`).join("")}</div></div>` : ""}</aside>` : ""}<aside class="pdf-security-statement"><span>Protection in place</span><p>${escapeHtml(securityStatement)}</p></aside></article><article class="pdf-overview-panel"><span>Network health & equipment age</span><h3>${escapeHtml(networkMessage.title)}</h3><div class="pdf-technology-recap"><article class="healthy">${reportIconHtml("check")}<span><strong>${lifecycle.current}</strong><small>Systems healthy</small></span></article><article class="attention">${reportIconHtml("computer")}<span><strong>${healthPriorities}</strong><small>Aging system${healthPriorities === 1 ? "" : "s"}</small></span></article><article class="os">${reportIconHtml("windows")}<span><strong>${osSummary.attention}</strong><small>OS item${osSummary.attention === 1 ? "" : "s"} to review</small></span></article></div><p class="pdf-environment-line">${[servers ? `${servers} primary server${servers === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "", backupServers ? `${backupServers} Cloud Plus backup server${backupServers === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "", workstations ? `${workstations} workstation${workstations === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "", vms ? `${vms} virtual machine${vms === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "", networkDevices ? `${networkDevices} network device${networkDevices === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}</p></article></div>
          <div class="pdf-review-story"><article class="protected">${reportIconHtml("shield")}<span><strong>Protection is active</strong><small>${incidents ? `${incidents} incident${incidents === 1 ? "" : "s"} documented` : "No incidents reported"}</small></span></article><i></i><article class="healthy">${reportIconHtml("activity")}<span><strong>${lifecycle.current} system${lifecycle.current === 1 ? " is" : "s are"} healthy</strong><small>Continue monitoring and normal maintenance</small></span></article><i></i><article class="plan">${reportIconHtml("plan")}<span><strong>${healthPriorities ? `${healthPriorities} aging computer${healthPriorities === 1 ? "" : "s"}` : "No aging systems need attention"}</strong><small>${healthPriorities ? "Advantage can help review replacement options when the timing is right" : "Continue normal monitoring"}</small></span></article></div>
          ${pdfFooter("Security & Technology Health")}
        </section>
    
        ${printHipaaReview}
        ${printHipaaAnswers}
    
        <section class="pdf-page pdf-action-page" data-pdf-page="true">
          <header class="pdf-section-header"><span class="kicker">${noActionNeeded ? "Technology status" : agreedPlan ? "Agreed plan" : approach.mode === "purchase-planning" ? "Recommended next step" : "Recommended plan"}</span><h2>${escapeHtml(planningTitle)}</h2><p>${escapeHtml(planningIntro)}</p></header>
          ${noActionNeeded ? "" : siteOverview}
          ${noActionNeeded
            ? `<div class="pdf-recap-roadmap pdf-no-action-roadmap">${recapRoadmapItems}</div>`
            : `<div class="pdf-consultation-banner${agreedPlan ? " agreed single" : appointment ? " scheduled" : approach.mode === "purchase-planning" ? " single" : ""}"><div>${reportIconHtml(agreedPlan ? "check" : "plan")}<div><span class="kicker">${escapeHtml(consultationKicker)}</span><h3>${escapeHtml(consultationTitle)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(consultationCopy)}</p></div></div>${consultationOutcomesPanel}</div>${actionHtml ? `<div class="pdf-recommendation-list">${actionHtml}</div>` : ""}`}
          ${pdfFooter(noActionNeeded ? "Technology Status" : agreedPlan ? "Agreed Roadmap" : approach.mode === "purchase-planning" ? "Recommended Next Step" : "Recommended Plan")}
        </section>
    
        ${actionContinuationPages}
    
        ${locationPackets}
    
        ${printHipaaFollowUp}
    
        ${printRecap}

    function proposalMoney(value: number): string {
      return value.toLocaleString("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD", minimumFractionDigits: 2 });
    }
    
    function proposalLineRows(project: Project, billing: "monthly" | "one-time"): string {
      const lines = includedProposalItems(project, billing);
      if (!lines.length) return `<div class="proposal-empty">No items are currently included in this part of the proposal.</div>`;
      return lines.map((line) => {
        const copy = proposalLineClientCopy(line, project);
        return `<article class="proposal-line"><div><strong>${escapeHtml(copy.name)}</strong><small>${line.quantity} × ${escapeHtml(proposalMoney(line.unitPrice))}${copy.description ? ` · ${escapeHtml(copy.description)}` : ""}</small></div><b>${line.requiresPrice && line.unitPrice === 0 ? "To be confirmed" : escapeHtml(proposalMoney(proposalLineTotal(line)))}</b></article>`;
      }).join("");
    }
    
    function proposalAssessmentPagesHtml(project: Project): string {
      const lifecycle = lifecycleSummary(project);
      const total = lifecycle.total || factNumber(project, "environment.totalComputers");
      const devices = sortLifecycleDevicesByPriority(inventoryReportDevices(project));
      const os = osSupportSummary(project);
      const storage = storageAttentionSummary(project);
      const firewall = factNumber(project, "security.firewallDisabled");
      const patching = factNumber(project, "patching.affectedComputers");
      const backup = factNumber(project, "backup.endpointMissing");
      if (!total && !devices.length && !firewall && !patching && !backup) return "";
    
      const deviceList = (values: string[], empty: string) => values.length
        ? escapeHtml(`${values.slice(0, 8).join(" · ")}${values.length > 8 ? ` · +${values.length - 8} more` : ""}`)
        : escapeHtml(empty);
      const firewallNames = factStrings(project, "security.firewallDisabledDevices");
      const patchNames = factStrings(project, "patching.affectedDeviceNames");
      const backupNames = factStrings(project, "backup.endpointMissingDevices");
      const securityPage = `<section class="page proposal-assessment-page"><span class="kicker">RFT technical assessment</span><h2>Security configuration snapshot.</h2><p>The RFT is the primary technical source for this proposal. It provides a point-in-time view of endpoint firewall, Windows update, and reported backup indicators—not a live threat activity report.</p><div class="assessment-metrics"><article><strong>${total}</strong><span>Computers reviewed</span></article><article class="${firewall ? "priority" : "healthy"}"><strong>${firewall}</strong><span>Firewall exceptions</span></article><article class="${patching ? "attention" : "healthy"}"><strong>${patching}</strong><span>Computers with update issues</span></article><article class="${backup ? "attention" : "healthy"}"><strong>${backup}</strong><span>Backup records to confirm</span></article></div><div class="assessment-detail-grid"><article class="${firewall ? "priority" : "healthy"}"><span>Endpoint firewall</span><h3>${firewall ? `${firewall} computer${firewall === 1 ? " was" : "s were"} reported with firewall off` : "No firewall-off records identified"}</h3><p>${deviceList(firewallNames, "No firewall exception was identified in the RFT.")}</p></article><article class="${patching ? "attention" : "healthy"}"><span>Windows updates</span><h3>${patching ? `${patching} computer${patching === 1 ? " needs" : "s need"} update remediation` : "No missing or failed update records identified"}</h3><p>${deviceList(patchNames, "No update exception was identified in the RFT.")}</p></article><article class="${backup ? "attention" : "healthy"}"><span>Recovery confirmation</span><h3>${backup ? `${backup} endpoint backup record${backup === 1 ? " needs" : "s need"} confirmation` : "No reported endpoint backup gaps identified"}</h3><p>${deviceList(backupNames, "Reported endpoint backup indicators did not require follow-up.")}</p></article></div><div class="assessment-note"><strong>Verification is part of onboarding.</strong><span>Advantage will confirm these configuration findings, the actual backup design, and any exceptions before final implementation.</span></div></section>`;
    
      const chunks: Array<typeof devices> = [];
      for (let index = 0; index < devices.length; index += 12) chunks.push(devices.slice(index, index + 12));
      if (!chunks.length) chunks.push([]);
      const inventoryPages = chunks.map((chunk, pageIndex) => {
        const rows = chunk.map((device) => {
          const osState = osSupportStatus(device);
          const storageState = storageStatus(device);
          const lifecycleLabel = device.type === "vm" ? "Virtual machine" : lifecycleStatusLabel(device.lifecycleStatus);
          const concerns = [
            lifecycleLabel,
            osState === "unsupported" ? "OS end of support" : osState === "ending-soon" ? "OS planning" : "",
            storageState === "critical" ? "Storage critical" : storageState === "watch" ? "Storage watch" : "",
          ].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
          return `<tr class="${device.lifecycleStatus} os-${osState}"><td><strong>${escapeHtml(clientDeviceDisplayName(device))}</strong><small>${escapeHtml([device.location, device.user].filter(Boolean).join(" · "))}</small></td><td>${escapeHtml(deviceTypeLabelForDevice(device))}</td><td>${escapeHtml(`${device.make} ${device.model}`.trim() || (device.type === "vm" ? "Virtual Machine" : "Not reported"))}</td><td><strong>${escapeHtml(device.os || "Not reported")}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(osSupportStatusLabel(osState))}</small></td><td>${escapeHtml(storageUsageSummary(device) || device.storage || "Not reported")}</td><td>${escapeHtml(concerns)}</td></tr>`;
        }).join("");
        return `<section class="page proposal-inventory-page"><span class="kicker">RFT hardware inventory${chunks.length > 1 ? ` · ${pageIndex + 1} of ${chunks.length}` : ""}</span><h2>${pageIndex === 0 ? "The systems behind the recommendation." : "Hardware inventory continued."}</h2>${pageIndex === 0 ? `<p>Virtual machines remain visible and are identified separately. Their operating system and storage still matter, while their physical lifecycle follows the host.</p><div class="assessment-metrics lifecycle"><article><strong>${lifecycle.current}</strong><span>Healthy now</span></article><article class="attention"><strong>${lifecycle.dueSoon}</strong><span>Plan soon</span></article><article class="priority"><strong>${lifecycle.overdue}</strong><span>Replace now</span></article><article class="attention"><strong>${os.attention + storage.attention}</strong><span>OS & storage concerns</span></article></div>` : ""}<table class="assessment-inventory"><thead><tr><th>Device</th><th>Type</th><th>Model</th><th>Operating system</th><th>Storage</th><th>Assessment</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows || `<tr><td colspan="6">The RFT summary was read, but detailed device rows were not available.</td></tr>`}</tbody></table></section>`;
      }).join("");
      return `${securityPage}${inventoryPages}`;
    }
    
    function prospectProposalHtml(project: Project): string {
      const orgTerm = organizationTerm(project);
      const orgReference = organizationReference(project);
      const supportTitle = supportHeading(project);
      const supportCopy = applicationSupportCopy(project);
      const applicationsCopy = applicationPlanningCopy(project);
      const workflow = workflowCopy(project);
      const lifecycle = lifecycleSummary(project);
      const osAssessment = osSupportSummary(project);
      const storageAssessment = storageAttentionSummary(project);
      const hasRftInventory = lifecycle.total > 0;
      const priorityCount = hasRftInventory ? lifecycle.overdue : project.findings.filter((item) => item.severity === "priority").length;
      const attentionCount = hasRftInventory ? lifecycle.dueSoon + osAssessment.attention + storageAssessment.attention : project.findings.filter((item) => item.severity === "attention").length;
      const healthyCount = hasRftInventory ? lifecycle.current : project.findings.filter((item) => item.severity === "healthy").length;
      const assessmentPages = proposalAssessmentPagesHtml(project);
      const proposalTypeLabel = project.type === "legacy-modernization" ? "Modernized Advantage 360 proposal" : "Advantage 360 proposal";
      const remotePlanning = isRemoteConsultation(project);
      const proposalPlanningLabel = planningModeLabel(project);
      const proposalPlanningHeading = remotePlanning ? "Consult with your Technology Consultant" : "Review the environment onsite";
      const proposalPlanningCopy = remotePlanning
        ? `During a consultation call, we will confirm the equipment, users, ${applicationsCopy}, vendor requirements, and preferred timing.`
        : `During an onsite project-planning review, we will confirm the equipment, users, ${applicationsCopy}, vendor requirements, connected systems, and timing.`;
      const proposalApprovalNext = remotePlanning
        ? `Advantage will confirm scope and availability during a consultation call with your Technology Consultant, complete the final service and project documents, and coordinate the transition with ${orgReference}.`
        : `Advantage will confirm scope and availability through an onsite project-planning review, complete the final service and project documents, and coordinate the transition with ${orgReference}.`;
      const hardware = proposalHardwareFinding(project);
      const replacementPattern = /server lifecycle|past the planned lifecycle|replacement timing|should be replaced/i;
      let hardwareInserted = false;
      const displayFindings = project.findings.map((item) => {
        if (hardware && item.category === "lifecycle" && item.severity === "priority" && replacementPattern.test(`${item.title} ${item.clientSummary}`) && !hardwareInserted) {
          hardwareInserted = true;
          return { ...item, title: hardware.title, clientSummary: hardware.summary, clientCategory: "Hardware" };
        }
        return { ...item, clientCategory: categoryLabel(item.category) };
      });
      if (hardware && !hardwareInserted) displayFindings.unshift({ id: "proposal-hardware-replacement", category: hardware.category, title: hardware.title, clientSummary: hardware.summary, severity: hardware.severity, evidenceIds: [], clientCategory: "Hardware" });
      const findings = displayFindings.map((item) => `<article class="finding ${item.severity}"><div><span>${escapeHtml(item.clientCategory)}</span><em>${item.severity === "priority" ? "Needs attention now" : item.severity === "attention" ? "Plan for" : "In good shape"}</em></div><h3>${escapeHtml(item.title)}</h3><p>${escapeHtml(item.clientSummary)}</p></article>`).join("");
      const scopeCount = includedProposalItems(project, "one-time").length;
      const warnings = proposalPricingWarnings(project);
      const signed = project.signature.status === "signed";
      const signedDate = project.signature.signedAt ? new Date(project.signature.signedAt) : null;
      const signedDateLabel = signedDate && !Number.isNaN(signedDate.getTime()) ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { month: "long", day: "numeric", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" }).format(signedDate) : "";
      const authorization = signed
        ? `<div class="signed-authorization"><span>Authorized by</span><strong>${escapeHtml(project.signature.signerName)}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(project.signature.signerTitle || "Authorized representative")} · ${escapeHtml(signedDateLabel)}</small></div>`
        : `<div class="signature-grid proposal-pdf-authorization"><label class="wide"><span>Decision</span><div class="pdf-form-marker pdf-form-choice" data-pdf-field="proposal.authorization.decision" data-pdf-field-type="choice" data-pdf-options="Approved|Not approved at this time" data-pdf-font-size="9"><i>Select Approved or Not approved at this time</i></div></label><label><span>Printed name</span><div class="pdf-form-marker" data-pdf-field="proposal.authorization.printedName" data-pdf-field-type="text"></div></label><label><span>Title</span><div class="pdf-form-marker" data-pdf-field="proposal.authorization.title" data-pdf-field-type="text"></div></label><label><span>Date</span><div class="pdf-form-marker" data-pdf-field="proposal.authorization.date" data-pdf-field-type="text"></div></label><label><span>Authorized signature or typed name</span><div class="pdf-form-marker" data-pdf-field="proposal.authorization.signature" data-pdf-field-type="text"></div></label><label class="wide"><span>Comments</span><div class="pdf-form-marker pdf-form-comments" data-pdf-field="proposal.authorization.comments" data-pdf-field-type="text" data-pdf-multiline="true"></div></label></div>`;
      const pricingNotice = warnings.length
        ? `<div class="proposal-warning"><strong>Final pricing will be confirmed.</strong><span>Final pricing will be confirmed after the project scope and application requirements are reviewed. Any changes will be discussed with you before equipment is ordered or work is authorized.</span></div>`
        : `<div class="proposal-note"><strong>Your investment is ready for review.</strong><span>Equipment availability, third-party licensing, taxes, freight, and vendor charges are included only when specifically listed above.</span></div>`;
      const proposalHipaaFollowUp = hipaaResponseAppendixHtml(project, "page");
    
      return `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>${escapeHtml(clientFacingDocumentTitle(project))}</title><style>

    type OutcomeHtmlOptions = { autoPrint?: boolean; includeTechnologyBudgetOutlook?: boolean };
    
    function autoPrintScript(): string {
      return `<script>(()=>{const printWhenReady=()=>window.setTimeout(()=>{window.focus();window.print()},350);if(document.readyState==="complete"){printWhenReady()}else{window.addEventListener("load",printWhenReady,{once:true})}})();</script>`;
    }
    
    export function outcomeHtml(project: Project, options: OutcomeHtmlOptions = {}): string {
      let html = project.type === "client-report" && clientReportAvailable(project)
        ? clientReportHtml(project)
        : project.type !== "client-report"
          ? prospectProposalHtml(project)
          : standardOutcomeHtml(project);
      if (options.includeTechnologyBudgetOutlook && project.type === "client-report" && clientReportAvailable(project)) html = injectTechnologyBudgetOutlookPdf(html, project);
      return options.autoPrint ? html.replace("</body>", `${autoPrintScript()}</body>`) : html;
    }
    
    
    function openPrintFallback(project: Project, options: Pick<OutcomeHtmlOptions, "includeTechnologyBudgetOutlook"> = {}): void {
      const printWindow = window.open("", "_blank");
      if (!printWindow) {
        window.alert("The fillable PDF could not be created and the browser blocked the print fallback. Please allow pop-ups, then try again.");
        return;
      }
      printWindow.document.open();
      printWindow.document.write(outcomeHtml(project, { ...options, autoPrint: true }));
      printWindow.document.close();
      printWindow.focus();
    }
    
    export async function downloadOutcomePdf(project: Project, options: Pick<OutcomeHtmlOptions, "includeTechnologyBudgetOutlook"> = {}): Promise<void> {
      if (project.type === "client-report") {
        const reconciliation = inventoryReconciliation(project);
        if (!reconciliation.passed) {
          window.alert("The authoritative Ninja / Client Compass inventory does not reconcile with the report output. Download inventory diagnostics and refresh source data before sharing.");
          return;
        }
      }
      try {
        await downloadFillableClientPdf(outcomeHtml(project, options), clientFacingDocumentTitle(project));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error("Fillable client PDF generation failed; opening browser print fallback.", error);
        window.alert("The fillable PDF could not be created in this browser. A print-ready version will open instead; choose Save as PDF.");
        openPrintFallback(project, options);
      }
    }

    import type { Project } from "@/lib/projects/types";
    import { normalizeCompassConfig } from "@/lib/compass/config";
    import {
      classifyTechnicalLifecycle,
      technicalLifecycleToReport,
      type TechnicalThresholds,
    } from "@/lib/technical-truth";
    import {
      compassLocationSnapshots as coreCompassLocationSnapshots,
      compassProjectPackages as coreCompassProjectPackages,
      lifecycleDevices as coreLifecycleDevices,
      lifecycleSummary as coreLifecycleSummary,

    } from "./client-report-data-core";
    
    export * from "./client-report-data-core";
    
    const COMPASS_CONFIG_KEY = "client-compass.configuration.v1";
    
    function currentLifecycleThresholds(): TechnicalThresholds | null {
      if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
      try {
        const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(COMPASS_CONFIG_KEY);
        if (!raw) return null;
        return normalizeCompassConfig(JSON.parse(raw) as unknown).thresholds;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
    }
    
    function lifecycleDeviceType(device: ClientReportDevice): "physical-server" | "physical-workstation" | null {
      if (device.type === "server" || device.type === "backup-server") return "physical-server";
      if (device.type === "workstation") return "physical-workstation";
      return null;
    }
    
    function applyCurrentLifecyclePolicy(
      project: Project,
      device: ClientReportDevice,
      thresholds: TechnicalThresholds | null,
    ): ClientReportDevice {
      const deviceType = lifecycleDeviceType(device);
      if (!deviceType || !thresholds) return device;
      const age = Number(device.age);
      if (!Number.isFinite(age) || age <= 0) return device;
    
      const lifecycle = classifyTechnicalLifecycle({
        deviceType,
        isVirtual: false,
        model: device.model || "Known hardware",
        ageYears: age,
        warrantyEnd: device.warrantyExpires,
      }, thresholds, coreReportReferenceDate(project));
    
      return { ...device, lifecycleStatus: technicalLifecycleToReport(lifecycle) };
    }
    
    /**
     * Client-facing lifecycle status must follow the saved Compass lifecycle policy.
     * The generator already carries the authoritative inventory age; do not replace
     * that real age with a generic age band or reclassify it with legacy defaults.
     */
    export function lifecycleDevices(project: Project): ClientReportDevice[] {
      const thresholds = currentLifecycleThresholds();
      return coreLifecycleDevices(project).map((device) => applyCurrentLifecyclePolicy(project, device, thresholds));
    }
    
    export function inventoryReportDevices(project: Project): ClientReportDevice[] {
      return lifecycleDevices(project).filter((device) => device.type !== "network");
    }
    
    export function reportableLifecycleDevices(project: Project): ClientReportDevice[] {
      return inventoryReportDevices(project).filter((device) =>
        (device.type === "server" || device.type === "backup-server" || device.type === "workstation")
        && device.lifecycleStatus !== "unknown"
      );
    }
    
    export function replacementDevices(project: Project): ClientReportDevice[] {
      return sortLifecycleDevices(reportableLifecycleDevices(project)).filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "overdue");
    }
    
    export function lifecycleSummary(project: Project): LifecycleSummary {
      const inventory = inventoryReportDevices(project);
      const physicalDevices = inventory.filter((device) => device.type === "server" || device.type === "backup-server" || device.type === "workstation");
      if (!physicalDevices.length) return coreLifecycleSummary(project);
    
      const current = physicalDevices.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "current").length;
      const dueSoon = physicalDevices.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "due-soon").length;
      const overdue = physicalDevices.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "overdue").length;
      const unknown = physicalDevices.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "unknown").length;
      const assessed = current + dueSoon + overdue;
      return {
        total: physicalDevices.length,
        inventoryTotal: inventory.length,
        assessed,
        current,
        dueSoon,
        overdue,
        unknown,
        healthyPercentage: assessed ? Math.round((current / assessed) * 100) : 0,
      };
    }
    
    export function compassLocationSnapshots(project: Project): ReturnType<typeof coreCompassLocationSnapshots> {
      const snapshots = coreCompassLocationSnapshots(project);
      const devices = lifecycleDevices(project);
      return snapshots.map((snapshot) => {

        const matched = devices.filter((device) =>

          replaceNow: matched.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "overdue").length,
          planSoon: matched.filter((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "due-soon").length,
        };
      });
    }
    
    function formattedAge(age: number): string {
      const rounded = age >= 10 ? Math.round(age) : Math.round(age * 10) / 10;
      return `${rounded} years old`;
    }
    
    function serverAgeDriver(devices: ClientReportDevice[]): string {
      const ages = devices.map((device) => Number(device.age)).filter((age) => Number.isFinite(age) && age > 0);
      if (!ages.length) return "";
      const oldest = Math.max(...ages);
      const status = devices.some((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "overdue")
        ? "Replace now"
        : devices.some((device) => device.lifecycleStatus === "due-soon")
          ? "Plan soon"

    function packageServers(

    }
    
    function clientFacingProjectPackages(project: Project): ReturnType<typeof coreCompassProjectPackages> {

          technicalDrivers: drivers,
        };
      });
    }

     * Project packages are an internal planning/estimation representation. Once a

      );

    }
